thesis: Every engine gate passes — no distress, clean usability, no event vetoes — but the engine's own valuation model prices this business at Rs 22.69 against a Rs 90.05 quote: a 297% premium for 0.66% ROE, 2.2% ROCE, and earnings that exist only when a project completes or a one-off lands. FY26's 'turnaround' (Rs 27cr PAT) rode Ten BKC completion and a BMC credit note; the core operation remains a lumpy, low-return land bank funded by serial equity dilution (promoter 63%->47% since FY21) and rising promoter pledges (29%->44.7% in 2026). This is a call option on Mumbai redevelopment execution, not a compounding business — and the option is priced as if already exercised.
